Equator Monument: Route & Location

The monument is on Jalan Khatulistiwa, Batu Layang, North Pontianak, Pontianak, West Kalimantan 78244. Plan from your actual departure point.

Map pin

Maps pin checked 19 October 2026: 0.000921, 109.3223955. This is a location aid, not a guarantee of road or entrance access.

Airport and city journeys

Use a current journey planner and your chosen transport operator. Confirm fare, pick-up, drop-off and return options; journey duration depends on traffic and the departure point.

Public transport and parking

A current direct service has not been verified. Ask operators before boarding and staff about permitted parking, capacity and charges.
